title: Selectors
definition: CSS Selectors define the HTML elements to which a set of CSS rules apply.
simpleExplanation: CSS is a sniper. Selectors are the scope. Before you can change the color of a button, you have to 'select' the button. You can target elements by their tag name (`button`), their Class (`.btn`), or their ID (`#submit-btn`).
realWorldExample: Using `.nav-link:hover` to select navigation links, but ONLY when the user's mouse is hovering over them.

basic: What symbol is used to select a Class, and what symbol is used for an ID?
intermediate: What does the selector `div p` (with a space) do?

answers.question: Class vs ID symbols?
answers.answer: A period (`.`) selects a Class (e.g., `.card`). A hashtag (`#`) selects an ID (e.g., `#header`).
